system.description:
An early type of aircraft that uses chemical fuel and a propeller. 2 passengers.

Distance of operation: 600km. Weight 1T, TL 5, speed band 4, cost 20,000cr.

Damage locations (book): Interior 1, Speed 4, Hull 1. The book gives no Handling value; Handling is set to the Hull value.

  • Air: This vehicle is designed to be flown in the atmosphere of a planet. Those operating vehicles with this trait benefit from using the Pilot (Aircraft) Skill.
  • Archaic: This vehicle is considered a rarity on higher tech worlds, so acquiring them or parts for them is difficult. Apply a -DM equal to the difference between the vehicle's lower tech level and the planet's higher tech level.

Cargo: For every one occupant slot, 50kg of cargo can be carried instead. Weapons can be added to a vehicle after purchase, but civilian vehicles are unarmed by default. Cruising speed: vehicles with speed band 3+ have a cruising speed equal to one speed band less than top speed (p.46).

Source: p.47.

Rotary-wing craft covers most common helicopters and similar vertical take-off craft. Eight occupants.

Distance of operation: 600km. Weight 1T, TL 6, speed band 4, cost 100,000cr.

Damage locations (book): Interior 2, Speed 4, Hull 2. The book gives no Handling value; Handling is set to the Hull value.

  • Air: This vehicle is designed to be flown in the atmosphere of a planet. Those operating vehicles with this trait benefit from using the Pilot (Aircraft) Skill.
  • VTOL: This craft can lift and land vertically without needing to use a runway or length of distance for ascending.

Cargo: For every one occupant slot, 50kg of cargo can be carried instead. Weapons can be added to a vehicle after purchase, but civilian vehicles are unarmed by default. Cruising speed: vehicles with speed band 3+ have a cruising speed equal to one speed band less than top speed (p.46).

Source: p.47.
